presentation.label: CARILLON
presentation.summary: A resonant filter bank: 32 narrow filters from C2 to C8, snapped to a key and scale. A filter at low Decay, ringing bells turned up.
presentation.overview: A resonant filter bank: 32 narrow filters from C2 to C8, snapped to a key and scale. A filter at low Decay, ringing bells turned up.
highlights: Use percussive hits and listen for separately ringing, tuned resonances.
usage: Add Carillon from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Use percussive hits and listen for separately ringing, tuned resonances.
Use the page buttons to reach the remaining controls.

access.location: Delay group in the MS-70CDR effect list, under Carillon.
steps: Add Carillon from the Delay group to a spare patch.
Use percussive hits and listen for separately ringing, tuned resonances.

controls.name: Cut
controls.doc: params[5]. Where the bank's emphasis sits, C2 .. above C8. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Reso
controls.doc: params[6]. Boost of the bands around Cutoff. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Decay
controls.doc: params[7]. Band width and ring: 0 one plain filter, 100 bells ringing a few seconds. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Key
controls.doc: params[8]. Named steps C .. B: the scale's root; in Free, moves the bank. Range 0–11.

controls.name: Scale
controls.doc: params[9]. Named steps: Free, Chrom, Major, Minor, Dor, Pent, MinPt, Whole, Fifth, Oct. Range 0–9.

controls.name: Waves
controls.doc: params[11]. 0..50 depth of a slow ripple across the bands; 50..100 full depth, faster. Range 0–100.

controls.name: Noise
controls.doc: params[12]. 0..50 random bands struck on their own; 50..100 adds a hiss that makes the bank whistle. Range 0–100.

limitations: Hardware untested on the original MS-70CDR with OS 2.10.
This build has startup knob initialization disabled. Check saved settings after recalling a patch.
